classification.resume: This is a 2007 Swiss TV news report from SF DRS Tagesschau covering a meeting of milk producers from Germany, Austria, and Switzerland discussing hopes for higher milk prices driven by rising demand for cheese, ice cream, and yogurt in Asia. It includes a statement by Albert Rösti, director of the Swiss Milk Producers' Association, alongside archival street scenes from China.
